title: Disordered activation domains enhance DNA target search rate of a bZIP transcription factor
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验研究bZIP转录因子CREB的无序激活域如何通过调节非特异性DNA结合亲和力来增强靶标搜索效率，虽以实验为主，但聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，对理解无序域在靶标搜索中的角色有启发，方法上缺乏AI或物理模拟。
abstract: Transcription factors typically contain an effector domain and a DNA-binding domain, and are predominantly disordered. There is increasing evidence that effector/activation domains contribute to the DNA target search process. However, exactly how those domains influence this search is still unclear. Here, we have purified full-length CREB, a bZIP transcription factor with long disordered activation domains. We found, using in-vitro stopped-flow kinetic and equilibrium binding experiments, that the full-length protein has high dimerization affinity and dimerizes before binding DNA, as recently shown for the standalone CREB bZIP domain. CREB contains three recognised intrinsically disordered activation domains, which fall into classical acidic and glutamine-rich classifications. We show that all three contribute to decrease general affinity for DNA. This, in turn, makes the target-search process more efficient by limiting CREB sequestration on non-target DNA. Thus, one of the ways in which intrinsically disordered, non-DNA-binding domains can affect target-search is by modulating non-specific DNA-binding affinity.
abstract_zh: 转录因子通常包含一个效应结构域和一个DNA结合结构域，且主要呈无序状态。越来越多的证据表明，效应/激活结构域参与DNA靶标搜索过程。然而，这些结构域究竟如何影响这一搜索过程仍不清楚。在此，我们纯化了全长CREB，这是一种具有长无序激活结构域的bZIP转录因子。我们通过体外停流动力学和平衡结合实验发现，全长蛋白具有高二聚化亲和力，并在结合DNA之前进行二聚化，正如最近针对独立CREB bZIP结构域所展示的那样。CREB包含三个公认的内在无序激活结构域，这些结构域属于经典酸性和富含谷氨酰胺的分类。我们表明，这三个结构域均有助于降低对DNA的一般亲和力。这反过来通过限制CREB在非靶标DNA上的隔离，使靶标搜索过程更加高效。因此，内在无序的非DNA结合结构域影响靶标搜索的方式之一，是通过调节非特异性DNA结合亲和力来实现的。
